attchmntText: Shree Ram Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Shree Ram Proteins Limited has approved the 18th Notice of the Annual General Meeting and the Director's Report for the year ended March 31, 2026. The Board of Directors considered these documents during a meeting held on November 07, 2026. The company will send copies of the notice and report to shareholders and stock exchanges in due course. The date of the Annual General Meeting for the year ended March 31, 2026, will be intimated later. Lalitkumar Chandulal Vasoya, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the intimation.

attchmntText: Shree Ram Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Shree Ram Proteins Limited reported a loss of Rs. 1,524.75 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and Rs. 2,161.15 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of Mr. Lalitkumar Chandulal Vasoya as Managing Director for three years from July 17, 2027. The Board also proposed the appointment of M/s H. Jamnadas & Co. as statutory auditors for five years, subject to shareholder approval. The company disclosed working capital shortages, covenant defaults, and unpaid statutory dues. Secured lender Union Bank of India sold plant and machinery for Rs. 382.00 lakhs and land and factory building for Rs. 1,676.30 lakhs via auction. The aggregate realization of Rs. 2,058.30 lakhs was appropriated against outstanding loans. The company recorded a net profit on sale of assets of Rs. 1,645.94 lakhs.
